title: Terrace-slab crack — measured vs guessed
sub: Terrace slab · Nov 2026 · Ref SC-25D35C5E · 2 INR coin (25 mm) for scale

photos.alt: Vertical crack in a terrace slab with a taped coin beside it and a yellow measuring tape held along the crack
photos.caption: Figure 1 — photo with tape: the measuring tape held along the crack is the ground truth (227 mm).

photos.alt: The same terrace-slab crack with the taped coin, photographed for the app measurement
photos.caption: Figure 2 — photo used for the guess: the same crack as the app measured it, photo + coin.

photos.alt: Bar chart: tape 227 mm, measured 218.5 mm inside ±10%, guess 315 mm outside
photos.caption: Figure 3 — the gap at a glance: the photo measurement lands inside the tape's ±10% band; the photo-alone guess does not.

photos.alt: Yellow string pinned along the crack on the parapet top, marking its full path
photos.caption: Figure 4 — string pinned along the same crack: the string follows every bend, then gets measured off the wall.

photos.alt: The pinned string beside a tape ruler, showing the string's measured length
photos.caption: Figure 5 — string against the tape: the string's length off the wall is the ground truth the app is checked against.

photos.alt: Close-up of the crack with a centimetre ruler alongside and pins marking it
photos.caption: Figure 6 — ruler close-up: the same crack against a centimetre scale, pins marking its course.

photos.alt: Close-up of the crack with a set square and pins at two points
photos.caption: Figure 7 — set square on the crack: pins at two points of the same crack.

photos.alt: Close-up of the crack with a set square, pins a few centimetres apart
photos.caption: Figure 8 — pinned interval: two pins a few centimetres apart on the same crack.

photos.alt: Close-up of the crack with a set square and two pins
photos.caption: Figure 9 — another pinned stretch of the same crack, ruler in frame.

photos.alt: Close-up of the crack with a set square laid diagonal and two pins
photos.caption: Figure 10 — diagonal set square on the same crack, two pins marking it.

photos.alt: Close-up of the crack with a set square and pins above and below
photos.caption: Figure 11 — pins above and below on the same crack, scale in frame.

photos.alt: Wide view of the full crack running down the parapet, pins along its length, phone for scale
photos.caption: Figure 12 — the whole crack: full run down the parapet with pins along it, phone for scale.

method: Outlines measured from photo pixels, scaled by the coin diameter (tilt-corrected from its ellipse). Ground truth is the builder's physical tape, 22.5–23 cm along the crack (midpoint 227 mm). Every number cites its evidence receipt.
verification: Evidence gate: passed · Independent skeptic: not run · Mask cross-check: not run

outcome: The photo measurement landed inside ±10% of the tape; the photo-alone guess did not. Bench case terrace-slab-tape-01.
